Assert Analysis Settings for CodeWAS

Source: R/fct_CodeWAS.R
assertAnalysisSettings_CodeWAS.Rd

Validates the analysisSettings list to ensure it contains the required elements (cohortIdCases, cohortIdControls, analysisIds, covariatesIds, minCellCount, chunksSizeNOutcomes, cores) with correct types and values. This function is specifically designed for checking settings related to CodeWAS analysis.

assertAnalysisSettings_CodeWAS(analysisSettings)

Arguments

analysisSettings

A list containing analysis settings. It must include the following elements:

cohortIdCases

A numeric value representing the cohort ID for cases.

cohortIdControls

A numeric value representing the cohort ID for controls.

analysisIds

A character vector of analysis IDs.

covariatesIds

A numeric vector of covariate IDs (optional).

minCellCount

A numeric value representing the minimum cell count, must be 0 or higher.

chunksSizeNOutcomes

A numeric value representing the chunk size for outcomes (optional).

cores

A numeric value representing the number of cores to use for parallel processing.

Value

Returns the validated analysisSettings list.
